blogPosts.title: Roadworthy Inspection Checklist for Oakleigh Vehicles
blogPosts.excerpt: A detailed guide to passing a roadworthy inspection in Oakleigh, covering key checks and tips from Glory Automotive experts.
body: A roadworthy inspection is mandatory for vehicle transfers or registrations in Victoria, and in Oakleigh, Glory Automotive ensures your car meets VicRoads standards. The checklist includes brakes, tyres, lights, steering, and structural integrity, all critical for safety on Melbourne roads. For Oakleigh drivers, preparing for this inspection involves regular maintenance to avoid last-minute surprises. Understanding the requirements helps you pass smoothly and keeps your vehicle in top condition.

Brakes are a primary focus, with checks on pads, rotors, and fluid levels for optimal stopping power. In Oakleigh's hilly terrain near the Dandenong Ranges, reliable brakes are essential. At Glory Automotive, we inspect brake systems using specialised tools, ensuring they meet the minimum thickness standards. Common issues like worn pads or glazed discs can be addressed during routine servicing, so Oakleigh residents should schedule regular checks to stay ahead of inspection requirements.

Tyres must have at least 1.5mm tread depth across three-quarters of the surface, with no cuts or bulges. Melbourne's winter wet conditions make tread depth vital for grip, and in Oakleigh, where streets can be slippery, this is non-negotiable. Glory Automotive measures tread depth and checks tyre age, replacing any that are over five years old to prevent failures. Proper tyre maintenance also includes correct inflation, which affects handling and fuel efficiency on Oakleigh commutes.

Lights and electrical components, including headlights, indicators, and brake lights, must function correctly for visibility and safety. In Oakleigh's darker winter months, faulty lights increase accident risks. Our technicians at Glory Automotive test all lights and wiring, fixing issues like dim bulbs or corroded sockets. Ensuring electrical reliability is part of our comprehensive inspection, tailored to Melbourne's variable weather and Oakleigh's suburban driving needs.

Steering and suspension systems are checked for play, leaks, and alignment, which affect control on uneven roads. Oakleigh's infrastructure, with speed bumps and rough patches, can wear these components over time. Glory Automotive inspects tie rods, ball joints, and shock absorbers, using precision equipment to detect issues early. A well-maintained suspension not only passes inspection but also provides a comfortable ride for Oakleigh drivers navigating daily traffic.

The vehicle's structure, including rust or damage to the chassis, is inspected for integrity. In Oakleigh's coastal humidity near Port Phillip Bay, rust prevention is important. Glory Automotive examines underbody and body panels, treating any corrosion to meet safety standards. Preparing for a roadworthy inspection in Oakleigh involves addressing these areas proactively, and our team at 40 Connell Rd offers pre-inspection checks to help you pass with confidence and avoid retesting fees.
